# **Global Climate Trends by Continent (2020-2025)**

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(flexdashboard)
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(scales)
library(readxl) 

df <- read_excel("Global_Climate_Change_Data_2020_2025.xlsx", sheet = 1)

df <- df %>%
  rename(
    Avg_Temperature = `Avg_Temperature(°C)`,
    CO2_Emissions = `CO2_Emissions(Mt)`,
    Sea_Level_Rise = `Sea_Level_Rise(mm)`
  )

df_time <- df %>%
  group_by(Year, Continent) %>%
  summarise(
    Avg_Temp = mean(Avg_Temperature),
    Avg_CO2 = mean(CO2_Emissions),
    Avg_Sea_Level = mean(Sea_Level_Rise),
    Avg_Risk = mean(Climate_Risk_Index),
    .groups = 'drop'
  )

df_latest <- df %>% filter(Year == 2025)

```

## **Row 1: Temperature and Sea Level Rise (Time-Series)** 

### Chart A : **แนวโน้มอุณหภูมิเฉลี่ย (°C)**

```{r}
p_temp <- ggplot(df_time, aes(x = Year, y = Avg_Temp, color = Continent, group = Continent,
                              text = paste("Year:", Year, "<br>Temp:", round(Avg_Temp, 2), "°C"))) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = unique(df_time$Year)) +
  labs(y = "Average Temperature (°C)", color = "Continent") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

ggplotly(p_temp, tooltip = "text")

```

### Chart B : **แนวโน้มระดับน้ำทะเลที่เพิ่มขึ้น (mm)**

```{r}
p_sea <- ggplot(df_time, aes(x = Avg_Temp, y = Avg_Sea_Level, color = Continent,
                             text = paste("Avg Temp:", round(Avg_Temp,2),"°C", "<br>Sea Rise:", round(Avg_Sea_Level, 2), "mm"))) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, linewidth = 1, linetype = "solid") +
  geom_point() +
  labs(x = "Average Temperature (°C)", y = "Average Sea Level Rise (mm)", color = "Continent") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

ggplotly(p_sea, tooltip = "text")

```

## **Row 2: Emissions, Risk, and Correlation**

### Chart C : **สัดส่วน CO₂ Emissions ในปี 2025**

```{r}
# สมมติฐาน: df คือ Data Frame ที่โหลดมา และมีคอลัมน์ชื่อ "CO2_Emissions"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# ขั้นตอนที่ 1: สรุปและคำนวณคอลัมน์ที่จำเป็น (Total_CO2 และ Percentage)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
df_co2_final <- df %>%
  # 1. จัดกลุ่มตามทวีป
  group_by(Continent) %>%
  # 2. คำนวณผลรวม (Total_CO2)
  summarize(
    Total_CO2 = sum(CO2_Emissions, na.rm = TRUE), # <<< ใช้ CO2_Emissions ที่ถูกต้อง
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  # 3. คำนวณเปอร์เซ็นต์ (Percentage)
  mutate(
    Percentage = Total_CO2 / sum(Total_CO2)
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# ขั้นตอนที่ 2: จัดเรียงและสร้างกราฟ (Bar Chart)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
df_co2_final <- df_co2_final %>%
  # 4. จัดเรียง Continent ตาม Total_CO2
  mutate(Continent = forcats::fct_reorder(Continent, Total_CO2))

p_co2_bar <- ggplot(df_co2_final, aes(x = Continent, y = Total_CO2, fill = Continent,
                                text = paste(Continent, "<br>", scales::percent(Percentage, accuracy = 0.1), " (", round(Total_CO2, 0), " Mt)"))) +
  
  geom_bar(width = 0.8, stat = "identity") +
  
  labs(x = "Continent", y = "Total CO2 Emissions (Mt)", fill = "Continent") +
  theme_minimal() + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# ขั้นตอนที่ 3: การแปลงเป็น Plotly (ปัญหาเดิมที่เคยเจอควรถูกแก้ไขแล้ว)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
ggplotly(p_co2_bar, tooltip = "text") %>%
  layout(title = list(text = 'CO2 Emissions by Continent (2025)'))


```

### Chart D : **ความสัมพันธ์ระหว่างอุณหภูมิและดัชนีความเสี่ยง (2025)**

```{r}
p_risk <- ggplot(df_time, aes(x = Year, y = Avg_Risk, fill = Continent, group = Continent,
                                text = paste("Year:", Year, "<br>Continent:", Continent, "<br>Risk Index:", round(Avg_Risk, 1)))) +
  geom_area(alpha = 0.6, position = 'identity') +
  geom_line(color = "black", position = 'identity', linewidth = 0.5) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = unique(df_time$Year)) +
  labs(x = "Year", y = "Average Climate Risk Index", fill = "Continent") +
  theme_minimal()+
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

ggplotly(p_risk, tooltip = "text")

```
